name: qa-cache-testing
description: Cache testing across layers: Redis cache patterns, CDN cache-purge testing (Cloudflare, Fastly, CloudFront), Varnish VTC syntax, browser Cache-Control tests, cache-coherence + stampede + stale-while-revalidate references, and a cache-key collision detector. Covers RFC 9111 HTTP caching and the canonical multi-tier cache discipline (browser to CDN to app to data store).
